title: tephroseris papposa subsp. wagneri
intro: Tephroseris papposa subsp. wagneri, commonly known as the mountain everlasting, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its potential to improve respiratory issues, reduce inflammation, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Tephroseris papposa subsp. wagneri include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its health benefits. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit various pharmacological activities.
